messages.author: 3fe90052fbf2f899
messages.subject: Re: Moderatoranalysis lavaan
parts: can anyone give me an example for the structure for moderation testing in a pathmodel with lavaan?

Yes, you just need to add the product term to your data.frame, then include that variable as a predictor in the syntax to estimate the interaction effect.  Or you can use the shortcut "x:z" (to represent the product x*z) as a predictor (e.g., "y ~ x + z + x:z").
